'''''Artemisiopsis''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the daisy family, [[Asteraceae]].<ref>Moore, Spencer Le Marchant. 1902. Journal of the Linnean Society. Botany. London 35: 331</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40020048 Tropicos, ''Artemisiopsis'' S. Moore ]</ref>

It contains only one known species, '''''Artemisiopsis villosa''''', native to eastern and southern [[Africa]] ([[Kenya]], [[Tanzania]], [[Angola]], [[Malawi]], [[Zambia]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Botswana]], [[Namibia]]) <ref name=l/>
